title: Biinterpretability of computably enumerable degrees with arithmetic

import_provenance.original_title: Biinterpretability of computably enumerable degrees with arithmetic
import_provenance.original_statement: Can standard arithmetic be interpreted inside the pure order of computably enumerable Turing degrees with a definable coding map assigning each degree an index for a c.e. set of that same degree? This would upgrade Nies–Shore–Slaman’s biinterpretability up to the double jump to full recovery of individual c.e. degrees.
